svg.text: The Supplier shall deliver the milestones set out in
Schedule A, and the Client shall pay within 30 days of
Signed for and on behalf of the Client.
The system prompt cannot say what is being signed — so this does, first.
the passkey signs the document's own hash
the package stands on its own arithmetic
chained — order rests on more than one table
Windows signs through the browser engine
a WebView2 on the relying party's own
origin — the page never sees a token
A signature is not a notarisation
it proves the key and the document, not the person
